tools.name: stock-moves-explained
tools.description: Explains why a stock had a significant price move today. Provides AI-written analysis citing news catalysts, earnings reports, and analyst actions. Covers every S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, and Dow stock, plus any stock a user adds to their portfolio. Pass any stock ticker or company name as the ticker para

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "stock-moves-explained" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Explains why a stock had a significant price move today. Provides AI-written analysis citing news catalysts, earnings reports, and analyst actions. Covers 550+ stocks across S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, and Dow 30. Pass any stock ticker or company name as the ticker parameter. NOT for: price quotes, trading" → after: "Explains why a stock had a significant price move today. Provides AI-written analysis citing news catalysts, earnings reports, and analyst actions. Covers every S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, and Dow stock, plus any stock a user adds to their portfolio. Pass any stock ticker or company name as the ticker para"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
